name: chart
useFor: Use for usage and activity over time (threads opened, pull requests merged, sandbox minutes) or a share (runs by agent). Wrap BarChart, LineChart, AreaChart or PieChart in ChartContainer with a config that labels each series (color is optional; the series tokens are the default), and add ChartTooltip with ChartTooltipContent and ChartLegend with ChartLegendContent. Give every chart an aria-label. Dependency free: no chart library.
constraints: Gradient fills beyond a faint area wash
Orange for anything but the series that matters
source: Extrapolated from the Hoplite website: its lines (the 16 and 32 percent rules), Kode Mono labels, the orange mark and the nav popup (.hn__panel) for the tooltip
title: Chart
description: SVG bar, line, area and pie charts: series in the ink first, the orange second and the gray steps after, a quiet hairline grid, Kode Mono axis labels, square bars and keys, and a small square tooltip panel with a Kode Mono label.
